name: The Gnawed Timeline
introDiscord:
Something has taken bites out of time.

Sections of the path simply skip.

A coral arch is young—

missing—

then ancient.
introTwitch:
Something has taken bites out of time.

Sections of the path simply skip.

A coral arch is young—

missing—

then ancient.

the-gnawed-timeline-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across The Gnawed Timeline.

left.message:
A treasure chest jumps from sealed to opened.

You loot it in the middle frame.

right.message: A surviving moment of rest restores you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Timeline Eater bites a section of the hallway out of existence.

the-gnawed-timeline-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Gnawed Timeline, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
The creature removes the moment BEFORE its attack.

Extremely rude.

right.message:
One Berry floats beside Shizuki's note:

'Lost ten minutes.

Glimmer says it was two hours.

Neither of us knows.

Berry remained fresh.'

forward.message: A cache exists in the portion of history that survived.

the-gnawed-timeline-threshold.prompt: Near Missing Century, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: Star Candies tumble from a missing afternoon.

right.message: A Timeline Eater chews through another sequence.

forward.message: A preserved peaceful moment restores you.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Missing Century
boss-antechamber.prompt: Missing Century opens like a hole in history.

bossPromptDiscord:
Missing Century opens like a hole in history.

Something enormous is feeding inside.

Use /yes to enter or /no to keep the remaining years
intact.
bossPromptTwitch:
Missing Century opens like a hole in history.

Something enormous is feeding inside.

Use !yes to enter or !no to keep the remaining years
intact.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Missing Century. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Whole eras vanish behind an enormous maw.

Epoch Devourer reveals itself!

completionText:
The timeline stops disappearing.

Nobody knows what belonged to the missing pieces.

Maybe that is the point.
